name: BPLPHARMA
business_description: BPLPHARMA is engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sale of pharmaceutical products. The company generates revenue by producing and selling medicines and related pharmaceutical formulations to distributors, hospitals, and pharmacies.
input_sensitivity: Cost risks include fluctuations in prices of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, packaging materials, energy, and labor. Revenue is sensitive to healthcare sector demand, regulatory approvals, and government healthcare spending.
output_note: Distributors, hospitals, and pharmacies pay BPLPHARMA for its pharmaceutical formulations and medicines.
